exchange-help: Set down one carried item and take this floor item in one choice. No fuel is spent. Undo reverses both parts.
exchange-return-help: The preview swaps one carried item for one floor item, then prices a return with that new weight. Nothing moves until you press Trade. The fallen arch and low lintel still apply.
unload-help: Put all carried treasure on this floor in one choice. Keep the flask, if you have it. Nothing is safe at the gate until you bank it.
drop-preview-help: Dropping costs no fuel, but the item stays in this room. The return estimate keeps everything else in your pack.
bank-one-help: Bank one carried item to keep the rest in your pack. The first banked item still closes the short arch. Banking only the flask spends it for fuel.
bank-item-preview-help: Banking one item leaves the others in your pack. The first banked haul closes the arch, even if that item is the flask. These numbers show the result of one press; arrival at the gate has not banked anything.
